fact: The SNDS 2020-2024, the second national strategy for the development of statistics, was adopted by the CNS in August 2020 with a five-year action plan costed at 34.81 billion FCFA.
title: Stratégie nationale de développement de la statistique (SNDS) 2020-2024
publisher: Ministère de la Planification du Développement et de la Coopération
